## What changed

Describe the focused behavior or documentation change.

## Why

Explain the user or maintainer problem and why it belongs in the desktop host
rather than upstream DeepSeek Harness.

## Validation

List the exact checks run and their results.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is limited to one reviewable concern.
- [ ] Behavior changes include or update tests.
- [ ] `npm test` passes locally.
- [ ] Relevant smoke checks pass, or the reason they do not apply is documented.
- [ ] English and Simplified Chinese user documentation remain synchronized.
- [ ] No credentials, private diagnostics, runtime downloads, or release outputs are committed.
- [ ] Signing and unsigned-release claims match the verified release state.
